# coralogix_product_analytics_settings (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    coralogix = {
      source = "coralogix/coralogix"
    }
  }
}

data "coralogix_product_analytics_settings" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Product Analytics is enabled for the team.
- `id` (String) The fixed id of this singleton: there is one per company.
